interruption_rule.buffer_oe_rule: any OE of a buffer that carries STEP, DIR or EN_N is either tied active (bank-A buffers: always enabled; power-off isolation by Ioff and receiver pull-downs) or is a qualified net that also clears an OPI latch on the card that holds the buffer (bank-B Ioff buffer on the motion card: OPI_BOE). An OE pulse too short to reach TX_PERMIT_B at the MX4 still clears OPI_BOE
interruption_rule.idle_pulls: 10 kohm pull-downs on the STEP and DIR inputs of every AM26C31 on the MIA and the MX4 (idle low, as the FPGA idles STEP low); EN_N inputs keep their 10 kohm pull-ups (LED dark). A floating input therefore rests at the idle level and cannot generate a counted edge
interruption_rule.output_card_latch: each DO and ACC card: OUT_EN latch (SN74LVC2G74DCUR half) with CLR_N = qualified OUT_PERMIT_k, D = 1, CLK = MCU strobe after a new epoch and IO_ENABLE; output enable = OUT_PERMIT_k AND OUT_EN.Q AND CARD_EN; any accepted OUT_PERMIT_k drop keeps the card's outputs off (SW_STATE written 0) until re-armed; ACC second half for PROC_PERMIT (PEN latch)
interruption_rule.fpga_reaction: OPI_OK_TX/A/B/BOE low while armed => OUTPUT_PATH_INTERRUPTED, disarm all, clear pos_continuity of the domain (TX and BOE: all channels / channels 8-11); OPI_OK_OUT low while I/O enabled => OUTPUT_PERMIT_LOST, I/O disabled

IS-1 keeps the part and the 20 ms requirement and changes only the timing capacitor to 3.3 nF CL10C332JB8NNNC, because with the normally-closed enable switch (tOFF up to 3 ms, 4 ms allocated) 17.87 + 4.31 = 22.18 ms would exceed 20 ms, while 12.67 + 4.31 = 16.98 ms meets it (17.33 ms with the CWD leakage allowance); the change is possible because progress pulses now come once per accepted command

request_rules.FPGA_MOTION_REQUEST: high only when armed with a valid CONFIGURE, the required mask equal to the armed mask and no fault, or in the SELFTEST state of the WD_M test (EN_N_i forced high, rates zero, process requests zero, PERMIT_OUT_REQ low)

request_rules.PERMIT_OUT_REQ: high only while armed and not in SELFTEST; 10 kohm pull-down

safety_interface.reset_arm: XS1.5: a press is accepted when released after reset_arm_press_min_ms and before reset_arm_press_max_ms while EXT_PERMIT is high; the release sets reset_arm_ready (safety word bit 30) for reset_arm_window_ms; ARM consumes it. With reset_arm_required = 1 (default) ARM without it is refused (ARM_REFUSED); 0 is allowed only when the profile declares a safety relay with its own manual reset feeding EXT_PERMIT (validator V-EL-12). A press longer than reset_arm_press_max_ms is 'stuck': event, ARM refused while it persists
safety_interface.contactor_fb: XS1.7 per contactor_fb_mode (1 NO auxiliary, 2 NC mirror): must read de-energized at ARM, energized within contactor_close_ms after TX_PERMIT rises, de-energized within contactor_open_ms after it falls; any mismatch latches CONTACTOR_FEEDBACK (fault bit 25), disarms all and refuses ARM until SYNC with the input agreeing
safety_interface.sto_fb: XS1.8 per sto_fb_mode (1 follows PERMIT_OUT: STO active exactly while PERMIT_OUT is open; 2 status only: STO active while armed is a fault) with sto_response_ms; mismatch latches STO_FEEDBACK (fault bit 26), disarms all, refuses ARM
safety_interface.chain_status: XS1.4 diagnostic only; disagreement with EXT_PERMIT longer than chain_mismatch_ms raises a SAFETY_INTERFACE event, no fault
